# Nexus - Open Source Social Study Mapping Tool (SSMT)

> Nexus is an interactive, open-source Social Study Mapping platform built with Next.js 16 and D3-force to visualize complex relationships, notes, and knowledge graphs.

Nexus turns fragmented notes, study concepts, and research data into dynamic, interconnected visual graphs. It features a 100% free Local Workspace mode with offline storage and zero login requirements, alongside real-time collaboration and cloud syncing.

## Core Features
- **Dynamic Force-Directed Graphs:** Interactive visual network visualization powered by D3-force engines with drag-and-drop nodes and custom shapes.
- **Local Workspace Mode:** Full offline functionality using browser LocalStorage with zero authentication required.
- **Real-Time Collaboration:** Synchronized project sharing and multi-user live editing powered by Supabase Realtime.
- **Drawing & Annotation Canvas:** Overlays shapes, lines, text, and custom groupings onto knowledge graphs.
- **Command Palette (Ctrl+K):** Instant navigation and quick-creation tools across projects, groups, and nodes.

## Technical Stack
- **Frontend Framework:** Next.js 16 (React 19, TypeScript)
- **Visualization Engine:** react-force-graph-2d & D3-force
- **State Management:** Zustand 5
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS 4
- **Backend API:** RESTful API with PascalCase to camelCase translation layer
